method.data: Only 1-second BTC bars are used. Missing seconds carry forward close and set volume to zero.
method.causal: Every signal uses data at or before the signal second and settles 600 seconds later.
method.selection: Ranking uses split metrics, recent 24h behavior, trade count, loss streak, and variance across thirds.
method.warning: This is research output, not a live configuration change.
